monitor.noTrainingHint: Start training to see real-time progress and parameters here
monitor.taskStateUnknown: Backend restarted; previous live task state is unknown
monitor.readyToTrain: Ready for a new training run
monitor.readyToTrainHint: Configure the training parameters and start training to see live data.
monitor.historyRenderError: Error displaying history. Check browser console (F12).
monitor.noLossData: Loss data will appear after training begins
monitor.diagnosticInsufficientSummary: At least 6 valid Loss points are required to assess the recent trend.
monitor.diagnosticConvergingSummary: The recent training Loss average keeps falling, so the optimization objective is still improving.
monitor.diagnosticPlateauSummary: Recent changes are small and stable; Loss may be entering a plateau.
monitor.diagnosticReboundSummary: The recent Loss average is clearly above the previous period.
monitor.diagnosticVolatileSummary: Recent Loss fluctuates a lot and training stability needs attention.
monitor.diagnosticSteadySummary: Recent volatility is controlled, but improvement is not yet significant.
monitor.diagnosticInsufficientAdvice: Diagnostics update automatically as Loss data arrives.
monitor.diagnosticConvergingAdvice: Continue with the current setup and use fixed-prompt samples to verify actual quality changes.
monitor.diagnosticPlateauAdvice: Use sample quality to decide whether to continue; open TensorBoard for details.
monitor.diagnosticReboundAdvice: Observe the next epoch first; if it persists, inspect learning rate and data.
monitor.diagnosticVolatileAdvice: Check learning rate, batch size, and outlier samples before stopping over a single step.
monitor.diagnosticSteadyAdvice: Keep watching sample quality and the next diagnostic window.
monitor.diagnosticEvidenceInsufficient: {count} valid Loss points are available; at least {minimum} are required to compare two adjacent periods.
monitor.diagnosticEvidenceConverging: The recent average fell {magnitude}, meeting the ≤ -{converging}% decrease rule; volatility {volatility} remains below the {volatile}% alert threshold.
monitor.diagnosticEvidencePlateau: The average change {magnitude} is < {plateauChange}% and volatility {volatility} is < {plateauVolatility}%, meeting the plateau rule.
monitor.diagnosticEvidenceRebound: The recent average rose {magnitude}, meeting the ≥ +{rebound}% rebound rule; rebound has first priority.
monitor.diagnosticEvidenceVolatile: Recent volatility {volatility} meets the ≥ {volatile}% alert rule; average change is {change}.
monitor.diagnosticEvidenceSteady: Average change {change} and volatility {volatility} match none of the decrease, rebound, high-volatility, or plateau rules.
monitor.diagnosticWindowEvidence: Step {recentStart}–{recentEnd} vs Step {previousStart}–{previousEnd} · {window} points per period
monitor.diagnosticMethodMeta: Engineering alert · not a quality score
monitor.diagnosticScopeText: This only analyzes training Loss, not sample images or validation Loss. It cannot determine image quality, overfitting, or the best checkpoint, and never stops training automatically.
monitor.diagnosticMethodSourceText: Prefers TensorBoard loss/average (the trainer moving average, typically covering about one epoch); falls back to noisier loss/current when unavailable.
monitor.diagnosticMethodWindowText: Compares averages from two adjacent equal windows. Target size is 15% of points, clamped to 12–60; short series use half the available points per window.
monitor.diagnosticMethodVolatilityText: Recent-window standard deviation divided by the absolute recent mean. It measures relative noise, not output quality.
monitor.diagnosticMethodNote: Long histories may be display-downsampled. Open TensorBoard for the complete curve, zooming, and point-level inspection.

monitor.noPreviewRunningHint: No samples yet — they appear after the first sample step
monitor.noPreviewHistoryHint: No preview samples in this run
monitor.noPreviewDisabledHint: Preview generation was not enabled for this run.
monitor.noPreviewArtifactUnavailableHint: The model output folder is unavailable because the drive is disconnected or the folder moved. Restore the path, then click Refresh to view preview images.
monitor.noLogsRunningHint: Waiting for log output from training...
monitor.noLogsIdleHint: Start a training task to see real-time logs here
monitor.noLogsHistoryHint: No log file in this run
monitor.noOutputsHint: Training outputs will appear here after saving
monitor.noOutputsNoRunHint: Start a training run or select a history record to view output files.
monitor.noOutputsArtifactUnavailableHint: The model output folder is unavailable because the drive is disconnected or the folder moved. Logs and TensorBoard remain available; restore the path to list or download model files.
monitor.outputFilesLoadFailed: Unable to read output files. Check the folder and click Refresh to try again.
monitor.artifactOfflineHint: The output drive may be disconnected, or the folder may have moved. Logs and TensorBoard remain available; restore the original path to recover models, previews and downloads.
monitor.confirmStop: Are you sure you want to stop training?
monitor.confirmDeleteRun: Delete this training record? Only the history, logs and TensorBoard data stored by the trainer will be removed. Models, checkpoints and preview images will be kept.

stepEstimate.epochFormulaMultiGpu: Per epoch: {batches} batches ÷ {gpus} GPUs ÷ accumulation {accumulation} = {steps} steps

field.pretrained_model_name_or_pathHint: Accepts .safetensors / .ckpt model files or a Diffusers-format directory.
field.pretrained_model_name_or_pathHint_anima: Select Cosmos-Predict2-2B derivative weights compatible with Anima.
field.vaeHint: Encodes between images and latents; optional for SDXL and required for Anima.
field.vaeHint_anima: Anima requires a compatible QwenImage VAE.
field.vaeHint_sdxl: Leave blank to use the VAE bundled with the SDXL base model.
field.krea_ditHint: LoRA training uses the RAW checkpoint. The Turbo checkpoint belongs only in the Turbo DiT field for samples generated during training.
field.krea_vaeHint: Encodes training images into the latent cache.
field.krea_text_encoderHint: Generates the text cache and is loaded temporarily for samples during training.
field.krea_dataset_cache_dirHint: Stored below the training data directory. Rebuild after changing images, captions, resolution, buckets, VAE, or text encoder. Changing the training DiT does not invalidate it.
field.krea_resolutionHint: Width and height must be positive multiples of 16, in width,height format.
field.krea_network_argsHint: One key=value per line, passed directly as the trainer's --network_args.
field.krea_weighting_schemeHint: logit_normal and mode change only sigma sampling density; sigma_sqrt and cosmap change only per-timestep Loss weights; none adds no adjustment.
field.krea_learning_rateHint: Controls the overall step size for DiT LoRA parameter updates. This training path has no separate text-encoder learning rate.
field.krea_logit_meanHint: Used by logsnr sampling and by timestep density with sigma + logit_normal.
field.krea_logit_stdHint: Used by logsnr sampling and by timestep density with sigma + logit_normal.
field.krea_mode_scaleHint: Changes sampling density only when timestep_sampling=sigma and weighting_scheme=mode.
field.krea_optimizer_weight_decayHint: Controls parameter shrinkage during updates. Whether decay is decoupled from the gradient depends on the selected optimizer; 0 applies no weight decay.
field.krea_optimizer_betasHint: Controls how much history is retained by the optimizer's exponential moving-average states. The required count and meaning of each value depend on the selected optimizer.
field.krea_optimizer_epsHint: A stability term added to adaptive-scaling denominators or related statistics to limit numerical amplification when a denominator approaches zero.
field.krea_prodigy_d_coefHint: Coefficient in the D-estimate expression (default 1.0); try 0.5 or 2.0.
field.krea_prodigy_d0Hint: Sets the initial D estimate for Prodigy and ProdigyPlus.
field.krea_schedulefree_warmup_stepsHint: Controls only AdamWScheduleFree linear warmup; external lr_warmup_steps and the LR scheduler do not apply.
field.krea_adafactor_relative_stepHint: When enabled, the entered LR is the initial value and AdaFactor derives later steps from training progress; the external scheduler does not apply. Disable it to use a normal external scheduler.
field.krea_adafactor_scale_parameter: Scale AdaFactor steps by parameter size
field.krea_adafactor_scale_parameterHint: When enabled, scales each parameter's step by that parameter's RMS. When disabled, the entered learning rate is used without parameter-RMS scaling.
field.krea_adafactor_warmup_initHint: Only applies in relative-step mode; AdaFactor performs the warmup internally.
field.krea_lr_scheduler_internalLocked: This optimizer manages its own learning rate, so the external scheduler is disabled; constant is shown only as a configuration placeholder.
field.krea_lr_scheduler_timescaleHint: Controls decay speed after warmup. Empty uses the warmup steps when nonzero, or 10000 when warmup is 0.
field.krea_lr_scheduler_min_lr_ratioHint: Minimum LR = base LR × this ratio. Used by cosine_with_min_lr, warmup_stable_decay, and rex; empty means 0.01 for REX and 0 for the other two.
field.krea_lr_scheduler_num_cyclesHint: For cosine_with_restarts this is the restart count; for cosine_with_min_lr it is the cosine cycle count; for warmup_stable_decay it is the final decay cycle count.
field.krea_fp8_baseHint: Dynamically quantizes target linear layers in the main DiT blocks at load time while leaving other layers at their original precision. Enabling it passes both fp8_base and fp8_scaled.
field.krea_compileHint: Compiles the Krea 2 DiT graph. The first run needs compilation time and compatibility depends on the current PyTorch, Triton, and GPU environment.
field.krea_text_cache_batch_sizeHint: Only affects text-cache preparation speed and VRAM usage.
field.krea_gradient_checkpointing_cpu_offloadH: Only selectable with gradient checkpointing enabled. The current Krea 2 version does not implement this offload, so enabling it has no effect yet.
field.krea_ratio_or_stepsHint: Use a whole number of steps, or a ratio below 1 (for example 0.1 means 10% of total steps).
field.krea_lr_decay_stepsHint: Used only by warmup_stable_decay. Enter whole steps or a ratio below 1 of total steps; 0 leaves no final decay segment.
field.krea_use_pinned_memory_for_block_swap: Use pinned memory for block swap
field.krea_use_pinned_memory_for_block_swapHin: Can speed up CPU-to-GPU transfers; on Windows it uses more shared GPU memory.
field.krea_block_swap_h2d_onlyHint: Avoids backward D2H transfers and requires gradient checkpointing.
field.enable_krea_samplesHint: Samples are written to the run's output/sample directory and temporarily load the text encoder at training start.
field.krea_sample_promptsHint: One prompt per line; sampling flags such as --w --h --s --g --d are supported.
field.krea_turbo_ditHint: Used for training samples and cannot be combined with block swap.
field.krea_turbo_dit_cache: Keep Turbo DiT resident in CPU memory
field.krea_turbo_dit_cacheHint: Faster samples, but uses roughly one additional DiT's worth of CPU RAM for the run.
field.resumeHint: Enter a save_state path to continue its optimizer, scheduler, and training progress.
field.enable_reg_dataHint: Uses regularization images to prevent overfitting.
field.reg_data_dirHint: Directory of regularization images. Same structure as the training dataset: subfolders named "repeats_classname" (e.g. 10_face). Must be a separate directory, not inside the training data directory.
field.resolutionHint: Enter width,height, for example 1024,768. Both Anima dimensions must be multiples of 16; SDXL dimensions must be multiples of 32.
field.enable_bucketHint: Selects a nearby training size for each aspect ratio to reduce cropping and stretching.
field.bucket_no_upscale: Do not enlarge small images during bucketing
field.bucket_no_upscaleHint: Prevents low-resolution images from being enlarged before training.
field.bucket_reso_stepsHint: Must be a positive multiple of 16 for Anima or 32 for SDXL.
field.save_every_n_steps: Model save interval in training steps
field.save_stateHint: Saves optimizer, scheduler, and training progress so training can continue through resume.
field.save_last_n_epochs_state: Number of epoch states to keep
field.train_batch_size: Images per batch on each GPU
field.train_batch_sizeHint: Theoretical effective batch = this value × gradient accumulation × GPU count; larger values use more VRAM.
field.gradient_accumulation_stepsHint: Accumulates gradients from N small batches before one parameter update. This can reduce per-step VRAM but produces fewer updates for the same amount of data.
field.gradient_checkpointing: Enable gradient checkpointing to save VRAM
field.gradient_checkpointingHint: Skips storing some intermediate activations and recomputes them during backpropagation. This saves VRAM but slows training.
field.learning_rateHint: Controls the overall parameter-update step size. A non-empty component rate overrides it for that component; otherwise the component uses this value.
field.unet_lrHint_anima: Empty uses learning_rate. Keeps the unet_lr parameter name but applies to the main DiT.
field.text_encoder_lrHint: Empty uses learning_rate; applies only when the text encoder is trained.
field.lr_schedulerHint: Defines the external curve applied to the base learning rate over training progress. When the optimizer manages step size internally, the external scheduler does not participate in training (except Prodigy, which still applies the external curve).
field.lr_scheduler_num_cyclesHint: Used only by cosine_with_restarts. 1 means a single cosine decay over the whole run; N means N decay segments (N−1 restarts).
field.weight_decayHint: Controls parameter shrinkage during updates. Whether decay is decoupled from the gradient depends on the selected optimizer; 0 applies no weight decay.
field.bnb_percentile_clippingHint: Scales gradients that exceed the selected percentile of recent gradient-norm history; 100 applies no percentile clipping. This processing is separate from max_grad_norm.
field.bnb_min_8bit_sizeHint: Tensors with fewer elements than this threshold retain 32-bit optimizer states. A larger threshold keeps more tensors in 32-bit state and increases optimizer-state VRAM.
field.stableadamw_kahan_sumHint: Compensates for rounding error in low-precision parameter updates. It can help FP16/BF16 trainable parameters and has little effect on standard FP32 LoRA parameters.
field.stableadamw_weight_decoupleHint: Uses AdamW-style decoupled decay. It has no practical effect while weight_decay is 0.
field.muon_adjust_lr_fnHint: match_rms_adamw keeps the update scale close to AdamW, so an AdamW-tuned learning rate carries over; original uses the upstream aspect-ratio scaling and usually needs its own learning-rate calibration.
field.muon_momentumHint: Controls how much gradient history contributes to the current update; normally leave it at 0.95.
field.muon_nesterovHint: Uses Nesterov momentum for the update before orthogonalization.
field.muon_ns_stepsHint: More iterations improve the approximation but take more compute; normally leave it at 5.
field.muon_ns_coefficientsHint: The three coefficients used by the Newton-Schulz iteration. Keep the defaults unless you are running a controlled comparison.
field.adan_weight_decoupleHint: Weight decay gently shrinks LoRA weights toward zero every step, preventing unbounded growth. When on, the shrink happens before the parameter update — the same as AdamW; the Adan library default scales the whole parameter after the update instead. At the default 0.01 the difference is tiny; turning it on mainly keeps results consistent with AdamW recipes shared by others. No effect when weight decay is 0.
field.ademamix_alphaHint: How much the slow gradient memory contributes to each update; the default 5 matches the paper. Larger values let gradients from thousands of steps ago keep influencing training; 0 disables the slow memory entirely, behaving close to AdamW.
field.ademamix_t_alphaHint: Ramps alpha linearly from 0 to its target over this many steps; the paper uses the total training steps. Ramping lets the slow memory accumulate before it starts steering updates, so early training is not skewed by an insufficiently accumulated memory. Leave empty to auto-fill the estimated total steps at launch; 0 disables the ramp.
field.ademamix_t_beta3Hint: Ramps the slow memory's decay β3 from β1 (0.9) up to its target (0.9999) over this many steps; the paper uses the total training steps. As a result, the slow memory responds quickly early in training and only gradually becomes a long memory. Leave empty to auto-fill the estimated total steps at launch; 0 disables the ramp.
field.lorarite_clip_unmagnified_gradHint: Suppresses the effect of occasional gradient spikes on the update; the default is sufficient in most cases. The norm is measured after removing the scaling induced by the LoRA factors. When LoRA-RITE is selected, the max_grad_norm field above (global gradient clipping threshold) locks to 0 and this setting takes over; 0 disables clipping.
field.stopcoefHint: EmoSens judges convergence from the medium-window loss moving-average level. This coefficient is the [READY TO STOP] trigger threshold; larger values trigger earlier more easily.
field.prodigy_d_coefHint: Coefficient in the D-estimate expression (default 1.0). The preferred Prodigy tuning knob; try 0.5 or 2.0.
field.prodigy_d0Hint: Sets the step-size scale estimate used by D-adaptation before the first update.
field.prodigy_safeguard_warmupHint: Enabled automatically with external LR warmup so warmup does not disturb the D estimate.
field.prodigyplus_use_stableadamwHint: Enables StableAdamW-style update RMS scaling. The internal scaling then handles update clipping and external max_grad_norm is fixed at 0 (also fixed when eps is empty).
field.schedulefree_warmup_stepsHint: Passed to AdamWScheduleFree as warmup_steps; external lr_warmup_steps has no effect for this optimizer.
field.adafactor_relative_stepHint: Lets AdaFactor derive LR from training steps; LoRA+ group rates are not used while enabled.
field.adafactor_warmup_initHint: Only used with relative_step; warmup is then managed inside AdaFactor.
field.adafactor_epsHint: Two-value format: eps1, eps2. eps1 applies to squared-gradient statistics and eps2 applies to parameter-scale calculation.
field.betasHint: Controls how much history is retained by the optimizer's exponential moving-average states. The required count and meaning of each value depend on the selected optimizer.
field.betasHint_adam: β1 controls retained history in the gradient moving average; β2 controls retained history in the squared-gradient moving average. Larger values retain more history.
field.betasHint_lion: β1 controls the mix of historical momentum and current gradient used to form the current sign-update direction; β2 controls the momentum state stored for later steps. Larger values retain more history.
field.betasHint_came: β1 controls the first-order state of the normalized update; β2 controls squared-gradient statistics; β3 controls squared residuals between the current normalized update and first-order state for confidence scaling. Larger values retain more history.
field.betasHint_prodigy: β1 and β2 control the first- and second-order states. D-adaptation's additional decay parameter is separate from this two-value input. Larger values retain more history.
field.betasHint_schedulefree: β1 participates in combining the current and averaged parameter sequences; β2 controls squared-gradient statistics. Larger values retain more history.
field.betasHint_adan: β1 controls the gradient moving average, β2 the gradient-difference (lookahead) term, β3 the squared statistics of the lookahead term. Larger values retain more history.
field.betasHint_ademamix: β1 controls the fast gradient moving average, β2 the squared-gradient statistics, β3 the slow gradient moving average; the closer β3 is to 1, the longer older gradients keep contributing.
field.epsHint: A stability term added to adaptive-scaling denominators or related statistics to limit numerical amplification when a denominator approaches zero.
field.epsHint_lorarite: LoRA-RITE's eps is a root epsilon: it is squared internally before use, so the default 1e-6 behaves like roughly 1e-12 in Adam terms — do not carry over the Adam-style 1e-8.
field.automagic_max_lrHint: Hard controller LR limit used to prevent numerical overflow.
field.automagic_clip_thresholdHint: Acts only on optimizer-internal updates; does not replace max_grad_norm.
field.automagic_polarity_historyHint: Tracks recent gradient-sign agreement for each parameter. A longer window retains more sign history and responds more slowly to new sign changes.
field.automagic_fusedLocked: Set to off. Reason: fused mode requires one GPU, gradient accumulation of 1, max_grad_norm of 0, and no FP16.
field.gradient_accumulation_steps_emosensLocke: Set to 1. Reason: EmoSens supports one update per step only.
field.emosensMultiGpuConflict: EmoSens conflict: gpu_ids is {value}; one GPU is required
field.came_weight_decoupleHint: When disabled, weight_decay enters the gradient as an L2 term. This switch has no effect when weight_decay=0.
field.came_fixed_decay: Keep per-step weight decay strength fixed
field.came_fixed_decayHint: Applies only with decoupled weight decay enabled. When enabled, the decay coefficient is no longer multiplied by the current learning rate.
field.came_clip_thresholdHint: Limits the root mean square of CAME's internal update tensor; this is separate from global max_grad_norm.
field.came_ams_boundHint: Uses the historical maximum second-moment estimate to bound adaptive step sizes so the denominator statistic cannot fall below the largest value recorded earlier.
field.came_eps1Hint: Denominator stability term for factorized squared-gradient statistics.
field.came_eps2Hint: Denominator stability term for residual-confidence statistics and update scaling.
field.optimizer_args_customHint: One key=value per line, passed to the trainer's --optimizer_args.
field.lr_warmup_steps_internalLocked: Set to 0. Reason: this optimizer manages learning rate internally and does not use external warmup steps.
field.lr_scheduler_locked: Set to constant. Reason: this optimizer manages learning rate internally and does not use the external learning-rate scheduler.
field.max_grad_norm_optimizerLocked: Locked to 0. Reason: this optimizer configuration uses its own clipping; global clipping is not stacked on top.
field.learning_rate_prodigyLocked: Set to 1.0. Reason: Prodigy-family optimizers use lr as the D-adaptation scaling factor.
field.unet_lr_prodigyLocked: Prodigy requires all learning rates at 1.0 (D-adaptation scaling); U-Net rate locked.
field.text_encoder_lr_prodigyLocked: Prodigy requires all learning rates at 1.0 (D-adaptation scaling); text encoder rate locked.
field.network_dimHint: Controls the low-rank channel count. Larger values add trainable parameters, optimizer state, checkpoint size, and VRAM use.
field.network_alphaHint: For LoRA-family algorithms the effective update scale is alpha / rank; with rs_lora it is alpha / √rank.
field.network_weightsHint: Enter an existing LoRA model path to initialize this training network.
field.enable_loraplusHint: Sets separate regular and plus group rates; incompatible optimizers disable this option.
field.enable_loraplus_optimizerLocked: Set to off. Reason: the current trainer does not support LoRA+ with Prodigy, ProdigyPlusScheduleFree, EmoSens, or LoRA-RITE; AdaFactor requires both relative_step and warmup_init to be disabled.
field.loraplus_lr_ratioHint: Default ratio for both UNet/DiT and text encoder; clear it to configure only one component.
field.loraplus_unet_lr_ratioHint_anima: Optional; overrides the global ratio. Keeps the unet parameter name but applies to the main DiT.
field.loraplus_text_encoder_lr_ratioHint: A non-empty value overrides the global LoRA+ ratio for the text encoder; an empty value leaves its effective LoRA+ rate determined by the global ratio.
field.scale_weight_norms: Maximum norm regularization for network weights
field.network_args_customHint: One key=value per line. loraplus_* is managed by the LoRA+ toggle and ratio fields, so custom copies are ignored.
field.base_weightsHint: LoRA weight paths merged before training, separated by commas.
field.base_weights_multiplierHint: Merge multiplier per base_weights entry, comma-separated; the count must match.
field.keep_tokensHint: After splitting the caption by its separator, the first N items are excluded from tag-order shuffling and tag dropout. Remaining items follow the enabled caption-randomization rules.
field.shuffle_captionHint: Randomizes tokens for each training sample; unavailable when Anima caches text-encoder outputs.
field.weighted_captionsHint: Supported only by the SDXL path. Anima tokenization does not support weighted tokens.
field.caption_dropout_rate: Probability of dropping the full caption
field.caption_dropout_rateHint: Randomly clears the full caption per training sample.
field.caption_dropout_rateHint_sdxl: Randomly clears the full caption per sample during training; incompatible with text-encoder output caching.
field.caption_dropout_rateHint_anima: Randomly clears the full caption per sample during training; rebuild disk text-encoder caches after changing it.
field.caption_tag_dropout_rateHint: Independently drops comma-separated tags during training; unavailable when Anima caches text-encoder outputs.
field.sample_promptsHint: The preview generator reads comma-separated tags or natural-language text. Example: 1girl, smile, cherry blossoms
field.sample_cfgHint: Affects only preview images generated during training; it does not change training.
field.sampleResolutionHint: Affects only preview dimensions. Higher resolutions use more VRAM and generation time.
field.sample_seedHint: An unchanged prompt and seed preserve the preview's random initial conditions, making changes across training stages easier to compare.
field.sample_stepsHint: More steps take longer to generate. This affects only previews, not training.
field.negative_promptsHint: Negative conditioning for previews; it affects only preview images generated during training.
field.mixed_precisionHint: BF16 has an FP32-like exponent range with fewer mantissa bits; FP16 has a narrower exponent range with more mantissa bits. Availability depends on GPU and framework support.
field.full_bf16: Cast model and LoRA parameters to BF16
field.full_bf16Hint: Available only with mixed_precision=bf16. Unlike regular mixed precision, model and trainable parameters also remain BF16.
field.full_bf16_automagicLocked: Automagic3 compatibility mode requires FP32 LoRA trainable parameters; full_bf16 is disabled.
field.xformersHint: Requires a compatible xformers installation; focuses on reducing attention VRAM.
field.sdpaHint: Uses the native PyTorch implementation with no extra extension dependency.
field.cache_latentsHint: Generates image Latents before training so VAE encoding is not repeated during training.
field.cache_latents_to_diskHint: Writes precomputed image latents to disk instead of keeping them only in memory. Switching from off to on also enables image-latent caching; disk I/O and cache-file storage increase.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputs_to_disk: Cache text encoder outputs to disk
field.no_half_vaeHint: Disables half-precision VAE computation, which isolates latent NaNs caused by the VAE's half-precision numeric range; higher-precision VAE computation uses more VRAM.
field.lowramHint: Reduces system RAM usage at the cost of additional VRAM.
field.v_parameterizationHint: Used only by SDXL models trained with a v-prediction target; it must match the base model objective.
field.zero_terminal_snrHint: Used only by SDXL and requires v_parameterization to be enabled.
field.max_grad_normHint: Scales gradients by their global norm before the parameter update; 0 applies no global clipping. Optimizer-internal clipping occurs at its own position in the update calculation.
field.huber_cHint: Base value of the Huber loss threshold, adjusted over training by the schedule; default 0.1.
field.huber_scaleHint: Controls the overall scale of the Huber Loss threshold. Default: 1.0.
field.qwen3Hint: Enter a .safetensors file path or a local HuggingFace model directory.
field.timestep_samplingHint: Controls how noise timesteps are sampled during training; see each dropdown option for its behavior.
field.sigmoid_scaleHint: Used by sigmoid, shift, and flux_shift to concentrate sampling toward the middle or ends of the noise range.
field.discrete_flow_shiftHint: Applies only with timestep_sampling=shift or sigma and shifts the FlowMatch timestep distribution.
field.weighting_schemeHint: The selected scheme may change sigma sampling density or per-timestep Loss weights; see each dropdown option for details.
field.logit_meanHint: Applies only with timestep_sampling=sigma and weighting_scheme=logit_normal.
field.logit_stdHint: Applies only with timestep_sampling=sigma and weighting_scheme=logit_normal.
field.mode_scaleHint: Applies only with timestep_sampling=sigma and weighting_scheme=mode.
field.min_timestepHint: Leave blank to use the default of 0.
field.max_timestepHint: Leave blank to use the default of 1000.
field.textTokenLengthHint: Captions beyond the limit are truncated. A token is a tokenizer segment, not the same as a character or tag count.
field.attn_modeHint: torch/SDPA use native PyTorch; xformers focuses on VRAM savings and needs an extra dependency; flash requires compatible hardware and an installed extension.
field.split_attnHint: Computes attention in chunks to reduce VRAM; enabled automatically when xformers is selected.
field.vae_chunk_sizeHint: Must be even. Reduces peak VRAM at a speed cost; empty disables chunking.
field.vae_disable_cacheHint: Disables the VAE internal cache to reduce VRAM, and encoding/decoding also becomes faster; this differs from official behavior.
field.blocks_to_swapHint: Offloads the specified number of DiT blocks to CPU, reducing resident VRAM at the cost of extra CPU/GPU transfers; 0 disables swapping. The limit of 8 is set by this application (the model itself allows up to 26).
field.conv_dimHint: Sets a separate rank for 3x3 convolutions in LoCon/LoHa/LoKr-type modules. Empty: native modules skip convolution layers; LyCORIS falls back to network_dim.
field.conv_alphaHint: Sets a separate alpha for convolution layers. Empty: native modules use 1.0; LyCORIS falls back to network_alpha.
field.lokr_factorHint: Splits each input and output dimension into two factors. A positive integer controls the factor limit used by the decomposition; -1 selects a more balanced factor pair. The resulting shapes change LoKr matrix dimensions and trainable parameter count.
field.use_tuckerHint: Applies Tucker decomposition to 3×3-or-larger convolution kernels to reduce parameters.
field.use_scalarHint: Used only by LyCORIS algorithms that support this parameter.
field.full_matrixHint: Used only by LyCORIS LoKr; enabling it disables low-rank decomposition.
field.train_normHint: Used only by LyCORIS and trains normalization layers such as LayerNorm, GroupNorm, and RMSNorm.
field.rank_dropoutHint: Randomly masks rank channels per sample during training and rescales the channels kept. It can be combined with neuron and module dropout.
field.module_dropoutHint: When triggered, skips the entire LoRA module and keeps only the base-model output. It can be combined with neuron and rank dropout.
field.lycoris_dropoutHint: Neuron dropout within LyCORIS modules; takes priority over network_dropout above if both set.
field.block_sizeHint: Must be a positive integer that divides network_dim.
field.constraintHint: Used only by OFT algorithms; 0 disables the constraint.
field.rescaledHint: Used only by OFT algorithms and rescales weight updates.
field.bypass_modeHint: Uses an identity mapping around the low-rank path; available only to LyCORIS algorithms that support it.
field.rs_loraHint: Scales low-rank updates by alpha / √rank for more stable high-rank training; supported only by some LyCORIS algorithms.
field.wd_on_outputHint: DoRA decomposition axis: output when enabled, input when disabled.
field.torch_compileHint: Compiles on first use; switch Windows inductor runs to eager if errors occur.
field.dynamo_backendHint: inductor favors performance; eager favors compatibility; cudagraphs reduces launch overhead.
field.dim_from_weights: Infer LoRA rank from existing weights
field.dim_from_weightsHint: Ignores network_dim and derives rank from existing LoRA weights.
field.cuda_allow_tf32Hint: Supported only on Ampere and newer GPUs; it may improve matrix performance on compatible hardware.
field.cuda_cudnn_benchmarkHint: The trainer benchmarks available cuDNN convolution algorithms for observed tensor shapes and caches the selected algorithm. Shape changes can trigger additional benchmarking.
field.vae_batch_sizeHint: Leave blank to use the default of 1. Larger batches can speed up caching but use more VRAM.
field.cpu_offload_checkpointingHint: Offloads checkpoint tensors to CPU; incompatible with Unsloth asynchronous offload.
field.unsloth_offload_checkpointingHint: Asynchronously offloads checkpoint tensors to CPU; incompatible with standard CPU checkpoint offload and block swapping.
field.compileHint: Compiles DiT block by block; automatically disabled when Block Swap is enabled.
field.compile_fullgraphHint: Requires torch.compile to capture the complete computation graph without graph breaks.
field.persistent_data_loader_workersHint: Reduces inter-epoch waits and is useful for large datasets; uses slightly more RAM.
field.max_data_loader_n_workersHint: Leave blank to use the default of 8. Lower values use less RAM; higher values can speed up data loading but use more system resources.
field.save_last_n_epochsHint: Use with save_every_n_epochs to limit disk space used by saved models. Leave blank for no retention limit.
field.save_state_on_train_end: Save final training state at training end
field.save_state_on_train_endHint: Saves optimizer, scheduler, and training progress once when training ends. This is independent of save_state, which writes training state alongside periodic model saves.
field.debiased_estimation_lossHint: Applies debiased per-timestep loss weighting; mainly for v-prediction training.
field.noise_offset_random_strengthHint: When enabled, the offset strength is sampled randomly between 0 and noise_offset.
field.noise_offsetHint: Adds a fixed offset to the noise, helping learn very dark or bright images; leave blank to disable.
field.adaptive_noise_scaleHint: Applies only after noise_offset is set and adjusts noise-offset strength from image statistics.
field.min_snr_gammaHint: Weights each timestep's Loss with the signal-to-noise ratio clamped at γ, limiting the relative weight of low-noise timesteps. Empty applies no Min-SNR weighting.
field.multires_noise_iterationsHint: SDXL multires noise iterations; ignored by Anima.
field.multires_noise_discountHint: Effective only when multires noise iterations are enabled.
field.ip_noise_gammaHint: Controls input-perturbation regularization strength; Anima applies it during noising.
field.ip_noise_gamma_random_strength: Random strength for input perturbation noise
field.ip_noise_gamma_random_strengthHint: When enabled, the perturbation strength is sampled randomly between 0 and ip_noise_gamma.
field.prior_loss_weightHint: Loss weight for regularization images. Default 1.0.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputsHint: Avoids encoding captions again during training.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputsHint_sdxl: Incompatible with caption dropout, shuffle, and tag dropout.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputsHint_anima: Incompatible with caption shuffle and tag dropout.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputsLocked: The current caption settings are incompatible with text caching.
field.network_dropoutHint: Randomly drops some features after LoRA down-projection during training. When the dedicated LyCORIS dropout is also set, only the dedicated value is used.
field.scale_weight_normsHint: Applies max-norm regularization to network weights at the entered limit; empty leaves weight norms unconstrained by this control.
field.sample_at_first: Generate a preview before training starts
field.sample_flow_shiftHint: Adjusts the flow-matching denoising schedule for Anima previews; it does not change the training timestep distribution.
field.samplePromptsCountHint: {n} prompt lines → {n} preview images per sample

opt.model_train_type_sdxl-lora: Stable Diffusion XL series LoRA training
opt.save_model_as_ckpt: PyTorch LoRA weights with a .ckpt extension
opt.save_precision_bf16: BF16 save precision, wider numeric range
opt.lr_scheduler_cosine: Cosine annealing, smoothly reduces learning rate
opt.optimizer_type_AdamW: Full-precision AdamW; FP32 optimizer states use more memory than the 8-bit versions.
opt.optimizer_type_AdamW8bit: AdamW with 8-bit optimizer states — same update rule, lower memory; this trainer's default.
opt.optimizer_type_PagedAdamW8bit: AdamW8bit with paging: swaps optimizer states to system RAM under memory pressure, slowing training while swapping.
opt.optimizer_type_StableAdamW: Adds RMS clipping of update magnitude on top of AdamW, capping per-step update size.
opt.optimizer_type_Lion: Sign updates: each step takes only the sign of a momentum/gradient mixture, so update size is independent of gradient magnitude and LR semantics differ from AdamW, generally calling for smaller values.
opt.optimizer_type_Lion8bit: Lion with 8-bit momentum state, for lower memory use.
opt.optimizer_type_PagedLion8bit: Lion8bit with paging: swaps momentum states to system RAM under memory pressure.
opt.optimizer_type_Prodigy: D-adaptation: estimates the step-size scale during training; base learning rate stays fixed at 1.0. The estimate needs some steps to converge, so very short runs may end before it does.
opt.optimizer_type_ProdigyPlus: Prodigy combined with Schedule-Free: automatic step-size estimation plus in-optimizer scheduling.
opt.optimizer_type_Automagic3: Adjusts per-group learning rates from gradient-sign history with internal update clipping.
opt.optimizer_type_AdaFactor: Factorized squared-gradient states for low memory; with relative_step on, the learning rate is derived from training progress.
opt.optimizer_type_AdamWScheduleFree: Replaces external learning-rate scheduling with parameter averaging.
opt.optimizer_type_CAME: Adds residual confidence scaling and internal RMS clipping to AdamW-style updates, with factorized states for lower memory.
opt.optimizer_type_EmoSens: Adjusts the global learning rate from a moving average of loss and raises a stop signal.
opt.optimizer_type_Muon: Accumulates gradient momentum, then approximately orthogonalizes the update of 2-D matrices.
opt.optimizer_type_Adan: Tracks consecutive-gradient differences as a lookahead term on top of Adam; effective step is larger than AdamW at the same learning rate and overfitting can also set in earlier, so the default learning rate is halved accordingly.
opt.optimizer_type_AdEMAMix: Maintains fast (β1=0.9) and slow (β3=0.9999) gradient moving averages so early gradients keep contributing to updates; designed for long runs — in short runs the slow memory has barely accumulated.
opt.optimizer_type_AdEMAMix8bit: AdEMAMix with 8-bit optimizer states; same update formula.
opt.optimizer_type_LoRARite: Purpose-built for LoRA's structure, removing update differences between equivalent reparameterizations of the same LoRA.
opt.krea_timestep_sampling_uniform: Samples timesteps uniformly across the full noise range.
opt.krea_timestep_sampling_sigmoid: Maps normal random values through sigmoid, producing a distribution concentrated toward the middle of the timestep range.
opt.krea_timestep_sampling_sigma: Uses weighting_scheme to select uniform, Logit-Normal, or Mode timestep density.
opt.krea_timestep_sampling_shift: Samples with sigmoid first, then shifts the distribution by fixed discrete_flow_shift.
opt.krea_timestep_sampling_krea2_shift: Computes the Krea 2 shift from the current resolution instead of using fixed discrete_flow_shift.
opt.krea_timestep_sampling_logsnr: Samples from the Log-SNR normal distribution defined by logit_mean and logit_std.
opt.krea_weighting_scheme_none: Changes neither timestep density nor per-timestep Loss weights.
opt.krea_lr_scheduler_inverse_sqrt: After linear warmup, decays in inverse proportion to the square root of the training step.
opt.krea_lr_scheduler_cosine_with_min_lr: Cosine decay down to the configured minimum learning rate.
opt.krea_lr_scheduler_warmup_stable_decay: Runs warmup, a stable constant phase, then a final decay phase.
opt.krea_lr_scheduler_rex: Warms from the minimum learning rate to the base value, then follows the REX curve back to the minimum.
opt.krea_attention_sdpa: Uses native PyTorch scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) without an additional attention-extension dependency.
opt.krea_attention_flash_attn: FlashAttention implementation; requires an installed build compatible with the current CUDA, PyTorch, and GPU.
opt.krea_attention_sage_attn: SageAttention implementation; requires a separately installed compatible version and supported GPU environment.
opt.krea_attention_xformers: xFormers memory-efficient attention; requires xformers and can be a compatibility option when VRAM is constrained.
opt.krea_optimizer_torch_sgd: Standard PyTorch SGD (no momentum by default).
opt.loss_type_default: Use the model's default loss function
opt.loss_type_l1: L1 Loss (MAE), more robust to outliers
opt.loss_type_l2: L2 Loss (MSE), more sensitive to large errors
opt.loss_type_huber: Huber Loss, combines advantages of L1 and L2
opt.loss_type_smooth_l1: Smooth L1 Loss, smoother near zero
opt.network_module_networks_lora: Standard LoRA network for SD/SDXL architectures
opt.network_module_networks_lora_anima: Anima LoRA network. Anima model is derived from NVIDIA Cosmos-Predict2-2B.
opt.network_module_lycoris_kohya: LyCORIS Library (DoRA, GLoRA, OFT, and more)
opt.lycoris_preset_full: All target layers in UNet/DiT and text encoder, including convolution
opt.lycoris_preset_full_lin: UNet/DiT and text-encoder linear layers, excluding convolution
opt.lycoris_preset_attn_mlp: Transformer attention and MLP layers, excluding convolution blocks
opt.lycoris_preset_attn_only: Attention layers and text-encoder attention layers
opt.lycoris_preset_unet_only: All UNet/DiT modules (including convolution); the text encoder is not trained.
opt.lycoris_preset_unet_transformer: UNet/DiT Transformer blocks only, excluding the text encoder
opt.lycoris_preset_unet_convblock: UNet convolution and ResNet blocks only; not applicable to DiT
opt.lycoris_preset_ia3: IA3 only: only to_k/to_v/ff.net.2 projection layers. Use only with IA3 algorithm
opt.sample_sampler_euler_a: Euler Ancestral sampler with stochastic steps
opt.mixed_precision_bf16: BFloat16 mixed precision; requires BF16 GPU support
opt.mixed_precision_no: No mixed precision (FP32), highest VRAM usage
opt.timestep_sampling_sigmoid: sigmoid — normal mapped through sigmoid, concentrated mid-range
opt.weighting_scheme_sigma_sqrt: Weights loss by 1 / sigma²; does not change the sampling distribution
opt.weighting_scheme_logit_normal: Samples timesteps from a Logit-Normal distribution only with sigma sampling; adds no loss weighting
opt.weighting_scheme_mode: Samples timesteps from the Mode distribution only with sigma sampling; adds no loss weighting
opt.weighting_scheme_cosmap: Applies Cosine Map loss weighting; does not change the sampling distribution
opt.weighting_scheme_none: Legacy compatibility value; identical to uniform
opt.weighting_scheme_uniform: Uniform density with no additional loss weighting (default)
opt.attn_mode_flash: Flash Attention; requires a compatible GPU and runtime
opt.huber_schedule_snr: SNR-based dynamic schedule, adaptively adjusts Huber threshold
opt.dynamo_backend_inductor: Default compilation backend focused on performance
opt.dynamo_backend_eager: Immediate execution backend focused on compatibility and debugging
opt.dynamo_backend_cudagraphs: Uses CUDA Graph to reduce kernel launch overhead
opt.compile_backend_inductor: Default backend focused on runtime performance
opt.compile_backend_eager: Immediate execution backend focused on compatibility
opt.compile_backend_cudagraphs: Reduces kernel launch overhead via CUDA Graph
opt.compile_dynamic_true: Enable dynamic shapes; Windows may require Visual Studio 2022 C++ tools
